cards.text: Same night, same table. Judas has gone out into the night, and Jesus has just told Peter he'll deny Him three times before the rooster crows (John 13:30, 38). Then Jesus says to the disciples around Him, "Do not let your hearts be troubled."

cards.question: Jesus tells the disciples they believe in God. What does He ask of them next?

answers.text: Wait for Him in the city

cards.text: Then Jesus paints a picture: in His Father's house are many rooms. Friend, I spent YEARS in a junk drawer sharing one corner with a takeout menu, so MANY ROOMS has my full attention.

cards.question: Jesus says He's going to His Father's house to prepare a ___ for the disciples.
True or false: Jesus says that once the place is ready, He will come back and welcome the disciples into His presence.

cards.text: Then Jesus tells them, "You know the way to the place where I am going." And Thomas, one of the twelve disciples, has a question.

cards.question: Jesus just told the disciples they know the way. What does Thomas say back?

answers.text: We don't even know where You're going
We'll follow You wherever You go
Then take us there with You now

cards.text: Honest question. That's me when a friend texts, "Meet me at the usual spot." WHICH spot? So Jesus answers Thomas.

cards.question: Thomas asked how they can know the way. What does Jesus say He is?

answers.text: The way and the truth and the life
The door and the light and the vine
The road and the gate and the guide

cards.question: True or false: Jesus tells Thomas there are many ways for people to come to the Father.

cards.text: Then Jesus says that if they had known Him, they would know His Father as well. And from now on, they do know Him and have seen Him.

cards.question: Philip, another of the twelve disciples, speaks up. He asks Jesus to show them the ___, and that will be enough for them.

cards.text: Jesus replies, "Philip, I have been with you all this time, and still you do not know Me?" Ooh. That's tearing the whole house apart for your sunglasses while they're sitting on your head.

cards.question: Philip asked to see the Father. What does Jesus say about anyone who has seen Him?

answers.text: They will see the Father one day
They are close to seeing the Father

cards.question: True or false: Jesus tells Philip that the words He says, He speaks on His own.
Jesus tells the disciples to believe that He is in the Father and the Father is in Him. True or false: He says they can at least believe on account of the works themselves.

cards.text: Then Jesus says, "Truly, truly, I tell you, whoever believes in Me will also do the works that I am doing." Even greater things, He says, because He is going to the Father.

cards.question: Jesus says He will do whatever the disciples ask in His ___, so that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

cards.text: Jesus keeps going, and this one's simple. "If you love Me, you will keep My commandments."

cards.question: Jesus says He'll ask the Father, and the Father will give the disciples someone to be with them forever. Who?
The Advocate is the Spirit of truth, and the world can't receive Him because it neither sees Him nor knows Him. True or false: Jesus says the disciples don't know Him either.

cards.text: Then Jesus says, "I will not leave you as orphans; I will come to you." Friend, I spent years in the back of a drawer, so that line gets me right in the apron.

cards.question: Jesus says that in a little while the world will see Him no more. What about the disciples?

answers.text: They will only hear His voice

cards.question: Jesus tells the disciples that because He lives, they also will ___.

cards.text: On that day, Jesus says, they will know that He is in His Father, that they are in Him, and that He is in them.

cards.question: Jesus says the one who loves Him is whoever has His commandments and keeps them. True or false: He says His Father will love that person too.

cards.text: Then a disciple named Judas speaks up, and the text makes sure we know: not Iscariot, the one who went out (John 13:30). Two men named Judas at one table, like two Mikes in one group chat.

cards.question: Jesus just said He'll reveal Himself to the one who loves Him. What does Judas ask?

answers.text: Why reveal Yourself to us and not the world
When will You reveal Yourself to us
How will we know that it is You

cards.question: Jesus answers Judas: whoever loves Him will keep His ___, and the Father and Jesus will come and make Their ___ with him.
Jesus says whoever doesn't love Him doesn't keep His words. Where does He say the word the disciples hear comes from?

cards.text: Jesus says He has told them all this while He is still with them. But He's not leaving them on their own.

cards.question: True or false: Jesus says the Advocate, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in His name, will teach the disciples all things and remind them of everything He has told them.

cards.text: Somebody to remind you of everything? I've hopped across my own bakery and forgotten why TWICE in one morning. Then Jesus says, "Peace I leave with you; My peace I give to you."

cards.question: Jesus gives the disciples His peace. What does He say about the way He gives?

answers.text: He does not give as the world gives
He gives only to those who ask
He gives it for a little while

cards.question: Jesus tells them again not to let their hearts be troubled. Then He says that if they loved Him, they would ___ that He is going to the Father, because the Father is greater than He is.

cards.text: Jesus says He's telling them before it happens, so that when it does happen, they will believe. And He won't speak with them much longer, because the prince of this world is coming, and he has no claim on Jesus.

cards.question: Jesus says He does exactly what the Father has commanded Him. Why?

answers.text: So the world may know He loves the Father
So the disciples will stay beside Him
So the prince of this world will flee

cards.text: Then Jesus says, "Get up! Let us go on from here." Hold on to your apron, friend, because the teaching isn't done. NOT. EVEN. CLOSE.

findings.problem: Judas and Peter appear for the first time in this lesson but the card never says who they are. Judas is just 'Judas', with no 'Iscariot' and no note that he is the disciple who would betray Jesus. Peter gets no introduction either. Stop 2 card 9 later refers back to Iscariot as 'the one who went out', but this card never named him Iscariot.

rule.text: New people. The first time someone shows up, he says simply who they are, like "Cyrus, king of Persia" or "Moses, Israel's leader."

findings.problem: This story card has four sentences: 'Honest question.' / 'That's me when a friend texts, "Meet me at the usual spot."' / 'WHICH spot?' / 'So Jesus answers Thomas.'

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

findings.problem: This story card has three sentences: the quoted question, 'Ooh.' and the sunglasses joke.

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

findings.problem: The answer is given away before this card. Card 11 already says the disciples 'do know Him and have seen Him' (the Father). Card 13's sunglasses joke then says the thing Philip is looking for is already right there. Together these rule out 'They will see the Father one day' and 'They are close to seeing the Father' before the baker reaches the question.

rule.text: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

findings.problem: 'Two men named Judas at one table' is not true at this point. Judas Iscariot has already gone out (John 13:30), so only one Judas is at the table. The card itself says this in the sentence before.

rule.text: Retelling: Papa Dorin can retell in his own words and fill in what the text clearly implies. Scene-setting details are fine. He never says anything the text shows is wrong.

findings.problem: This story card has three sentences: the 'Somebody to remind you of everything?' question, the bakery joke and the quote from 14:27.

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

findings.problem: This story card runs past two sentences: the two-sentence quote ('Get up! Let us go on from here.'), then 'Hold on to your apron, friend...', then 'NOT. EVEN. CLOSE.'

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

findings.problem: Multiple choice dominates stop 2. It has 6 multiple choice cards, 3 true or false and 3 fill in the blank, so half the choice cards are multiple choice and there are twice as many as either other type.

rule.text: No stop repeats another stop's pattern, and no type dominates a stop by a wide margin.
